guide.greenlantern.title: Corps Manual
guide.greenlantern.welcome.title: Welcome
guide.greenlantern.welcome:
You have been chosen! This manual teaches everything a new Green Lantern needs to know.

§aFirst steps§r
1. Craft a §2Power Ring§r (diamond + emeralds).
2. Craft a §2Power Battery§r and place it.
3. Click the battery with the ring in hand to charge it: a new ring comes empty.
4. Right-click with the ring (or press §eG§r) to put on the uniform.
5. Double-tap jump to fly and hold §eR§r to pick a construct.

Use the chapters on the left, the ◀ ▶ arrows below or the mouse wheel to navigate. Recipes are in the Recipes chapter.
guide.greenlantern.ring.title: Power Ring
guide.greenlantern.ring:
The ring is the source of all your powers: the uniform, flight and hard-light constructs.

§aEnergy§r
The ring stores up to 5000 energy. The bar shows on the item, in its tooltip and on the HUD in the top-left corner. Every construct costs energy to create, and some drain a little per second while they exist. Flying drains energy too, and the faster you fly, the more it costs.

When energy is low the HUD blinks red. With no energy left the uniform fades and constructs vanish.

§aUse§r
Without the uniform, right-click puts it on. With the uniform, right-click uses the selected construct.

The ring doesn't burn in lava or fire.
guide.greenlantern.battery.title: Power Battery
guide.greenlantern.battery:
The Power Battery is the lantern that recharges your ring.

§aCharging§r
Place the battery, hold the ring and right-click it. Energy flows from the lantern into the ring while you stay close, and the Corps oath appears on screen. Click again to stop.

You hear a chime when the ring is full. If you walk too far away, charging stops.

Take a battery on your travels: it can be mined with a pickaxe and placed again anywhere.
guide.greenlantern.uniform.title: Uniform
guide.greenlantern.uniform:
With the ring in hand, right-click or press §eG§r to put on the Corps uniform: hard-light mask, suit, leggings and boots.

§aProtection§r
The uniform protects like diamond armor. You need it to fly and to use constructs.

§aYour armor is kept safe§r
When you put the uniform on, the armor you were wearing is stored. Press §eG§r again to remove the uniform and you get it back.

Uniform pieces can't be taken off in the inventory or dropped.
guide.greenlantern.flight.title: Power flight
guide.greenlantern.flight:
With the uniform on, §edouble-tap jump§r to take off (or stop flying). Near the ground, take-off releases a burst of energy.

§aSpeed§r
Hold §eW§r and your speed keeps growing. With §eCtrl§r (sprint) it grows faster. After a few seconds you break the §asound barrier§r: sonic boom, vapor rings and "SUPERSONIC" on the HUD. You fly where you look.

§aManeuvers§r
• Double-tap §eA§r or §eD§r at high speed: barrel roll.
• Hold §eS§r at high speed: air brake.
• Dive into the ground fast: hero landing, a shockwave that throws nearby creatures (you take no damage).

Hitting a wall head-on at speed kills your momentum. The ring protects you from fall damage.
guide.greenlantern.constructs.title: Constructs
guide.greenlantern.constructs:
Constructs are hard-light objects created by your willpower.

§aPicking one§r
Hold §eR§r to open the construct wheel: point with the mouse and release (or click). On the wheel, keys §e1-6§r and the mouse wheel work too. A quick tap on §eR§r picks the next one, and §eShift + mouse wheel§r with the ring in hand also switches.

§a1. Energy Blast§r: click to launch a sphere that explodes on impact without breaking blocks.

§a2. Minigun§r: hold right-click for a continuous burst.

§a3. Protection Bubble§r: click to toggle. Absorbs most damage, pushes creatures away and reflects projectiles. Drains energy per second.

§a4. Giant Saw§r: a vehicle with a circular saw in front. Shreds creatures and cuts trees, leaves and plants. §eW/S§r drive, §eA/D§r strafe, the mouse steers, jump hops and sneak gets off.

§a5. Giant Hammer§r: a hammer appears where you look and slams the ground with a shockwave.

§a6. Giant Drill§r: a vehicle that bores and mines. See the next chapter.
guide.greenlantern.drill.title: Giant Drill
guide.greenlantern.drill:
The Giant Drill is a digging vehicle: you sit in a cockpit on tracks with a huge drill bit in front.

§aUsing it§r
Select the drill (construct 6) and right-click to summon it and climb in. Click again or sneak to get off.

§aDriving§r
• §eW§r moves where the bit points. The bit follows your aim.
• Looking ahead you drive and bore straight tunnels with a flat floor.
• Look down to dig shafts and up to bore through the ceiling.
• §eS§r reverses, §eA/D§r strafe, jump hops.
• Against rock the drill grips the walls, so you can stop halfway down a shaft. In open air it falls.

§aMining§r
The drill bores a tunnel big enough for itself and its rider and mines stone, dirt, sand, gravel and every kind of ore, including deepslate and Nether ores. Hard blocks like obsidian take longer. Bedrock is never broken. Mined items go straight to your inventory (whatever doesn't fit drops at your feet), and ores drop experience.

§aWeapon§r
The spinning bit hurts and pushes creatures that touch it.

§aTip§r
The drill drains energy every second: charge the ring before a long expedition and bring a Power Battery.
guide.greenlantern.controls.title: Controls
guide.greenlantern.controls:
Keys can be changed in §eOptions → Controls → Key Binds → Green Lantern§r.

§eRight-click§r (ring): put on the uniform or use the construct.
§eG§r: put on / remove the uniform.
§eR§r (hold): construct wheel.
§eR§r (tap): next construct.
§eShift + mouse wheel§r (ring in hand): switch construct.
§eDouble-tap jump§r: take off / stop flying.
§eW§r while flying: accelerate. §eCtrl§r: accelerate faster.
§eA A§r or §eD D§r flying fast: barrel roll.
§eS§r flying fast: air brake.
§eW A S D§r in vehicles: drive. §eJump§r: hop. §eSneak§r: get off.
§eRight-click the Battery§r: charge the ring.
guide.greenlantern.recipes.title: Recipes
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_ring: A diamond on top and four emeralds forming the band. The ring comes out empty: charge it at a Power Battery before using it.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.power_battery: Iron ingots in the corners, lime stained glass on the sides, a lantern in the middle and an emerald block below.
guide.greenlantern.recipe.guide_book: A book and an emerald, in any position. Craft another manual if you lose yours.
guide.greenlantern.tips.title: Tips
guide.greenlantern.tips:
• In Creative mode, the §2Green Lantern Corps§r tab has a ring that is already charged.

• Keep an eye on the energy bar. Vehicles (saw and drill) and the bubble drain energy all the time.

• Use the Giant Saw to gather wood and the Giant Drill to mine: both are great weapons too.

• The bubble reflects arrows and other projectiles.

• Supersonic flight costs up to 3 times more energy.

• Every number in the mod (energy, costs, damage, speeds, whether the drill mines or the saw cuts plants) can be tuned in §econfig/greenlantern-common.toml§r. Visual effects and the flight music are in §econfig/greenlantern-client.toml§r.

"In brightest day, in blackest night, no evil shall escape my sight!"
